## Data Validation

### Load the data
From the sandpit data

### Completeness check (Overall)
How many rows contain a null value
Which columns have the most missing data

### Completeness check (by site)
Are there any sites with a higher amount of missing data
Any particular combination of site and column that has a problematic amount of missing data?

### Review categorical columns (unique values of text columns)
This isn't needed here for the current feature list but in future iterations it could be considered.

### Review distribution of columns (categorical)
For columns with catgorical values, what is the distribution of different values.
Are any values impossible for this data set?
Which categorical columns need grouping to prevent any one-hot translation being excessive.

### Review distribution of columns (continuous)
What is the distribution of numeric columns?
What is this by site?

### Heatmap
Plot overall correlation in the data (note the current data set is just June 2024)
